crossRefs.note: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one…
He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings, and those…
Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer…
Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords.

translations.web: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
translations.bsb: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
translations.kjv: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
translations.asv: And he hath on his garment and on his thigh a name written, KINGS OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
